meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: 执行书面计划时,Claude 成为总指挥:它把任务拆分并并行派发给多个子代理去写码和测试,自己不直接实施,同时维护进度状态和证据记录。
howto.when: 当用户说出“ulw-execute”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 目录下的计划时触发。若此时没有可选的计划,会先通过 ulw-plan 生成新计划,再继续执行。

say.text: 运行 ulw-execute,开始执行当前工作计划
say.note: 进入计划执行与任务分派流程

say.text: 执行 auth 计划并加上 --make-pr
say.note: 每完成一个阶段会生成一个 Pull Request

say.text: 没有现成计划,直接用 ulw-execute 帮我建计划
say.note: 先启动无计划引导,自动生成计划

howto.what_en: While executing a written plan, Claude acts as the orchestrator: it splits tasks and spawns multiple parallel subagents to code and test, never implementing itself; it keeps track of progress state and evidence records.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'ulw-execute' or asks to run a plan from .omo/plans. If no plan is available, it bootstraps a new plan via ulw-plan before proceeding.

say_en.text: Run ulw-execute and start the current work plan.
say_en.note: Enters plan execution and task dispatch.
Opens a pull request after each completed phase.

say_en.text: No plan yet — run ulw-execute to create one.
say_en.note: Bootstraps a plan via ulw-plan first.
